budget_items.what_was_recorded: The updated roof cost estimate was reported at $48,000, with excavation/foundation, materials, and code-compliant roof structure figures given.
budget_items.quote: dave informed the committee that the updated cost estimate for the roof is $48,000.

budget_items.topic: Waste categories by cost and volume
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Six waste types were reported as 87% of volume and 85% of cost; oil based paint 32% and pesticides 21% of waste collected.
budget_items.quote: six types of waste which represent 87% of the waste by volume and 85% by cost.

budget_items.quote: dona reported that not all receipts were included in the massdevelopment report.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposed KPIs include total costs per load, revenue per load and labor cost to be tracked.
